divisions.title: The LORD Avenges
divisions.summary: God's character revealed as jealous avenger who reserves wrath for enemies while sheltering those who trust him.

divisions.title: The Fall of Nineveh
divisions.summary: Vivid imagery of Nineveh's siege, plunder, and total devastation as divine judgment against the bloody city of lions.

chapterSummaries.1: God's jealous vengeance against Nineveh declared through theophanic imagery of storm and earthquake, contrasted with refuge for those who trust.
chapterSummaries.2: The siege of Nineveh depicted with chariots, scarlet warriors, and flooding gates as the lion's den is emptied and plundered.
chapterSummaries.3: Woe to the bloody city full of lies and plunder, compared to fallen Thebes, destined for disgrace with no healing for her wound.
